How many speakers do I need for my event?

Up to about 50 guests, two powered speakers and a microphone; 50 to 200, a PA with subwoofers and wireless mics; above 200 or a live band, a stacked or flown system with an engineer. Send the space and the guest count and we will size it.
Can I rent speakers for a party in NYC?
Yes. A pair of powered speakers with a mic, or a full party PA with subwoofers, delivered, set up and picked up anywhere in the five boroughs.
Do the speakers come with someone to run them?
Yes. We set up and test every system, and an engineer can stay to mix the event.
Can I rent speakers with lights and a stage?
Yes. Uplighting, stage lighting, stage decks and screens come from the same crew, planned with the sound and billed on one quote.
It depends on the size of the system, the hours and whether an engineer stays. Send the date, the space and the guest count and we reply with an itemized quote.
